text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
After all, aren't we buddies who are going to
sprint through the Twinkle Series together?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
I need to get to know you better,
and you need to get to know me better too.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
To make that happen, I want to spend more time with you.
I want to share all kinds of experiences—Don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of the party arrives after her invitation.
As we make our way to the venue with our costumes in hand...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Are you nervous?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's fair. ...But don't worry, okay?
After all, today is a "theme party"!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Once you change into your spy outfit at the venue,
the excitement will blow all your nerves away! ...We're fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so she told me, but...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Wow.
Looks like an adorable little mouse sneaked in.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Checkmate—just kidding! Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer!
Oh! You look like the absolute picture of an "undercover office worker"♪

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, a hotelier!
Quite an unexpected twist, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Heart! Is the person next to you your rumored Trainer?
Nice to meet you~! Cheers to that☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The venue is even livelier than I imagined, and I wonder if I can keep up.
I want to do my best so as not to embarrass Heart, though...

text_block_list.name: Announcement Chime
text_block_list.text: (Wooo! Wooo!)

text_block_list.name: Host Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hello everyone! Now that everyone's gathered,
we'll be kicking off the "Best Agent Look Contest"!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
The "Best Agent Look Contest".
Basically, it's a disguise contest.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Using the provided costumes and props,
you disguise yourself to fit whatever "mission" you're given!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: I'm entering, but what about you two?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm in! Totally entering!
What about you, Trainer? Gonna join? Are you, are you?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Truth be told, I'm not very comfortable being in the spotlight.
However, as Dearing Heart's Trainer...
choice_data_list: M-Maybe I'll give it a shot...!

text_block_list.name: Host Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Next up! The mission for Agent Dearing Heart is...
"Sheltered Highborn Lady"!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good day to you all, ladies and gentlemen.
Allow me to play a melody as a token of our acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SCREEECH, SKREEE)

text_block_list.name: Host Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Wait, she can't play it at all! ...Alright, moving on!
Our next agent is this young lady's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Host Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
The mission for this agent is—"Sizzling Top Idol of the Moment"!
Alright, take the stage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As my nervousness reaches its absolute limit, a calm voice in the back of my mind speaks up.
..."If you're going to fall, you might as well fall forward."

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Wow...
choice_data_list: I'm not letting you go home today... Run with me!
I'm not letting you go home today... Run with me!

text_block_list.name: Party Guests
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! So cool~♡

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, my gosh. You are an eager beaver.
You really do give it your all, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fancy that! Who knew you had that in you?
The crowd went absolutely wild.
choice_data_list: Ahaha... As long as everyone enjoyed it, that's what matters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That said, it took a massive toll on both my energy and stamina.
I'd really love to spend some quiet time resting, but...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
If we follow the usual flow, next up should be dance time.
I'll be heading out on the floor, but you can rest...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
What?
Aren't you exhausted, though?
choice_data_list: ...I just wanted to get used to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to work as her Trainer,
I need to be able to keep up with this kind of vibe...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
—No.
I appreciate the thought, but that's a no thanks, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you when I invited you?
My objective today is "mutual understanding."

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
The goal is to understand who you are.
Pushing yourself too hard just to join in completely misses the point.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
...You should be able to relax and take it easy inside the house.
You can still watch everything happening out here, too.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Go on and take a break.
—Thank you for working so hard for me today!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you changed, Heart?
Where are you going? The restroom?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Non. I'm a bit tired, so I'm taking a break.
Catch you later.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: —Now then...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are.
...Wait—Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the clamor outside sounding in the distance,
I find myself staring intently at my notebook when...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
"From posture alone, Guest A clearly has athletic experience. Exceptional physical ability.
Unlikely to pass as an ordinary citizen disguised."

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Guest B's outfit is elaborate. Perfectionist mindset. Possibility of
deep expertise in this genre. Could serve as a potential icebreaker."

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Are these... analysis notes on the guests?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was only observing from afar at first... but as I watched,
my Trainer instincts must have switched on without me realizing it.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: I'm shook...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
This is unbelievable!
You're amazing, Trainer! Every single one is spot-on!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
A is that girl in the dress, right?
She's actually a black belt in judo!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
And B is that girl over there, right? She's completely obsessed with spy movies
and cosplays all the time.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Did you figure all of this out just by watching them?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm excited!
That basically makes you a real secret agent!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey. What about the others? If you don't mind, I'd love to see the rest of your analysis!
Let's check your answers!
choice_data_list: I don't mind, but are you sure you want to ignore the party?
I don't mind, but are you sure you want to ignore the party?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you can be so dense about the weirdest things!
I want you to use those inquisitive eyes of yours to look at me a little closer.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Today, I really got to know you.
How great you are at analyzing things, and how you push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
So... look at me too, okay?
You know what I mean.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her give a charming wink, the lingering guilt in my chest melted away.
Before I knew it, a natural smile formed on my face.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, found your answer?
Well then, let's see how you did, Mr. Master Agent♪
